question.text: Cross-asset risk appetite long → does the Shanghai composite print any close above the entry price in the next 5 sessions?
legs: Factor 1 — SSE 5Y government bond ETF up over 20 sessions (yields down)
Factor 2 — yuan stronger over 20 sessions (USDCNY down)
Factor 3 — small caps ahead of large caps over 20 sessions (SZSE / SSE)
Factor 4 — VIX above its one-year median
question.rule: Average the four standardised factors and mark a point above the 90th percentile of all history up to that day. The entry price is that session's close; the call is a hit if any of the next 5 closes is above it. No CPI/NFP/FOMC layer: those calendars and the news labels are American inputs, not an A-share signal.

legs.label: SSE 5Y govt bond ETF up (yields down)
small caps vs large caps (SZSE / SSE)

imported.entry: the first SSEC session after the US signal day (entry = that session's close)
